order: Score the initial forty-item corpus blind against the sealed reference pass, record the result against the pre-registered threshold, and if missed, redraw the class boundaries and apply the redraw to the plan. Diagnose the root cause of any concentrated disagreement pattern rather than patching individual items. Add a precedence rule to the relevant preamble: recall signals are hints only, and the requested work product plus the discriminator decide from intake text alone; rename the affected column to match. Amend the discriminators implicated by the disagreements and add new ones only where a genuine gap is found, plus phase-ordering rules for diagnosis-before-implementation and composite orders. Record the reference pass, the disagreement ledger, the redraw, and a post-redraw resolution of the flagged items, explicit that this is a scoring reference, not a validation. Gate the downstream order on a fresh blinded mini-corpus at a pro-rated threshold, since the original items are burned for blinding.
claims: The blind pass scored 31 of 40 (77.5 percent) against the pre-registered threshold, with two ambiguities at the cap and nine disagreements across nine distinct pairs concentrated on one class's borders and the diagnosis frontier, traced to boundaries drawn in outcome space but decided at intake. The redraw was applied: a precedence rule was added, discriminators amended, new ones added only where needed, and two phase rules introduced. The pass, ledger, redraw, and a resolution of all ten flagged items were recorded as a scoring reference, not a validation; the downstream order is gated on a fresh blinded corpus.
